description.value: Biryani Palace is a halal Indian and Pakistani restaurant on Quadra Street in Victoria, specializing in slow-cooked dum biryani, tandoori dishes, and a broad menu of curries and kebabs. The restaurant features an open-concept kitchen where guests can watch dishes being prepared with traditional methods and authentic ingredients. They also offer full catering services for events of any size.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 19m; stands at 19m; rack at 83m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record name, address, and category. The site explicitly advertises dine-in, takeout, and delivery, and the menu lists a dedicated vegetable/vegetarian section including Veggie Dum Biryani. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities was found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250 385 4747 was sourced from the website only and could not be cross-checked against OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Victoria with a confirmed website and full address. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated Vegetable section and Veggie Dum Biryani; catering copy references vegetarian platters. No mention of vegan or GF specifically

wow_evidence: open-concept kitchen where guests can watch dishes being prepared with traditional methods
